info.name: E-Commerce Laravel API (v1)
info.description: All endpoints of the Laravel storefront + admin API (base path /api/v1). Run "Login" and "Admin login" first — they auto-store the bearer tokens into the {{customer_token}} and {{admin_token}} collection variables.

request.description: Stores data.token into the {{customer_token}} variable automatically.
Profile shape. To replace addresses send { addresses: [ ... ] } (full-array replace).

Purchase-gated: requires a delivered, non-returned order for that product.
